value.rationale: The Pappus Levi graph is a classical 18-vertex cubic symmetric graph, a natural exact benchmark for graph expansion, cutwidth, and MinLA. A nested optimal ordering is a nontrivial condition, not automatic from scalar expansion or finite vertex-transitivity. The complete 19-level boundary profile, multiplicities, simultaneous sharp layout values, and number of all optimum orders answer natural layout/cut-optimization questions and provide a reproducible finite test case.
